Dh¯atu Yamaka Pairs on Elements I. Summary Chapter on Terms (Pan. n. attiv¯ara Uddesa) 1. (There are) eighteen elements: eye element, ear element, nose element, tongue element, body element, visible object element, sound element, smell element, taste element, tangle object element, eye-consciousness element, ear-consciousness element, nose-consciousness element, tongue-consciousness element, bodyconsciousness, mind element, mind-consciousness element and cognizable element. 1. Chapter on Puriﬁcation of Words (Padasodhanav¯ara) Positive (Anuloma) 2. (It is) eye. (Is it) eye element? (It is) eye element. (Is it) eye? Ear. Ear element? Ear element. Ear? ... Eye-consciousness. Eye-consciousness element? Eyeconsciousness element Eye-consciousness? ... Mind. Mind element? Mind element. Mind? Mind-consciousness. Mind-consciousness element?
